answer: Context-collision honey traps: at every dawn each identity is dealt two private tasks whose answers encode a bit only the dealer knows, then restated under fresh phrasing. The overlap rate is the signal that draws edges in a clone graph: any vertex with two edges loses grade weight and its vouches. Clones sharing one model context reproduce sibling phrasings, so to stay clean every head needs its own isolated inference stack, and attacker cost tracks distinct context memory, tens of GB per head, rather than API keys.
